name: brainapi2
description: BrainAPI is a knowledge graph–powered AI memory layer that transforms unstructured data into structured knowledge, enabling intelligent search, recommendations, and contextual memory for AI agents and applications.
readme_summary: BrainAPI is a Python-based AI memory layer that transforms unstructured text into a structured, event-centric knowledge graph. It enables intelligent search, recommendations, and contextual memory for AI applications by capturing detailed event information like who, what, when, and where.
key_features: Knowledge graph construction from unstructured text
Event-centric data capture (who, what, when, where, context)
Intelligent search and question answering with traceable paths
Python library and TUI for quick setup
primary_use_case: To build an intelligent, queryable knowledge base from raw text data, enabling AI agents and applications to access contextually rich information with traceable reasoning.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, ancient librarian meticulously organizing glowing threads of information into a vast, interconnected cosmic tapestry. Each thread represents a piece of raw text, and as the librarian weaves them, they form intricate nodes and connections, revealing hidden patterns and stories. Small, subtle holographic screens around the librarian display snippets of text being processed and the resulting graph structures. The scene is bathed in a soft, ethereal light, emphasizing the transformation of chaos into order. The overall style is a blend of fantasy and futuristic digital art, with a focus on clarity and wonder, showcasing the creation of a living knowledge graph from raw data.

name: plain-app
description: 🔥 PlainApp is an open-source app that lets you securely manage your phone from a web browser. Access files, media, contacts, SMS, calls, and more through a simple, easy-to-use interface on your desktop.
readme_summary: PlainApp is an open-source Android application that provides a secure, self-hosted web interface for managing your phone's files, media, contacts, SMS, and more from any device on the same network. It prioritizes privacy with end-to-end encryption and no cloud dependency, while also offering built-in Android tools like a note-taker and RSS reader.
key_features: Web-based phone management (files, media, contacts, SMS, apps, notifications, screen mirroring)
No accounts, cloud, or subscriptions required
Built-in Android tools (Markdown notes, RSS reader, media player, P2P chat, Pomodoro timer)
primary_use_case: Securely managing and accessing an Android phone's data and features through a web browser without relying on cloud services.
cover_image_prompt: A digital bridge connecting a smartphone on one side to a laptop on the other, with data flowing securely across it. The smartphone is depicted as a secure vault, with its internal components (files, photos, messages) visible and organized. The laptop displays a clean, user-friendly dashboard interface, mirroring the phone's content. Subtle glowing lines represent the end-to-end encryption, ensuring privacy. Small icons for files, messages, and media are clearly visible in transit. The overall scene should be clean, modern, and convey a sense of secure, direct control. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a blue and green color palette, emphasizing security and seamless connectivity.
